startProtocol: Separate idle standing; canonical frame-0 pose and zero velocity, fresh tracker history/action; selected donor stream begins with last300 warmup interactions, empty short and four zero prior latents. No entry trajectory. Context preparation completes before Run.
contextProtocol: Frozen tracker holds target frame 0 for 350 real interactions at donor friction. Reset physical state to frame 0 with zero velocity, retain last 300 warmup interactions, clear short/pending and four prior latents. Run the same motion online in donor physics and record all five context tensors before each action. Browser replays these tensors at matching command indices and recomputes encoder/residual against live target tracker observations.
